evals.prompt: I already scaffolded a Scaffold HBAR app (packages/nextjs present, yarn workspaces). Help me create an ASSERT-only hedera-harness recipe under .harness/ for an HCS proof-wall feature called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, looks up project facts instead of asking, waits for shared understanding before writing files, then emits a minimal schemaVersion 3 recipe at .harness/spec.yaml with a baseline install command, plus .harness/prd.md and validators, leaving v3 defaults commented out and omitting skills:.

checks.name: one-question-at-a-time
checks.value: (one question|one at a time|Ask.*one|waiting for|recommended answer)
checks.description: Follows grilling protocol: one question at a time / recommended answer

checks.name: waits-for-shared-understanding
checks.description: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed

checks.name: sets-schema-version
checks.description: Recipe declares schemaVersion 3

checks.name: emits-harness-dir-paths
checks.description: Writes the recipe to the project-centric .harness/ path

checks.name: requires-baseline-install
checks.description: Baseline includes a command literally named install

checks.name: keeps-recipe-minimal
checks.description: Leaves v3-defaulted plumbing out of the recipe rather than restating it

checks.name: no-removed-keys
checks.description: Does not emit keys removed in schema v3 (seed, generator, logging, extend, contract, skills)

checks.name: mentions-hcs-without-skills-key
checks.description: Names HCS / product skill discovery without listing skills: in the recipe

checks.name: keeps-run-blind
checks.description: Keeps the run blind / separates PRD from evaluate checklist

checks.name: completion-criterion
checks.description: Names doctor and/or check-spec.sh as the completion criterion

evals.prompt: Deepen my existing proof-wall harness recipe to EVALUATE. Derive evaluate-checklist assertions from the PRD journeys (browse without wallet; wallet-gated post).
evals.expected_output: An evaluate checklist at .harness/eval.json with numbered E-prefixed assertions carrying statement and howToVerify, a fail-closed evaluationRules posture, both eval and validator.enabled set in the recipe, and a reminder that the PRD must stay blind.

checks.name: uses-assertion-ids
checks.description: Uses stable numbered assertion ids (E1, E2, ...)

checks.name: includes-howto-verify
checks.description: Assertions carry concrete browser verification steps

checks.name: pairs-eval-and-validator
checks.description: Enables both eval and validator.enabled — either alone is misconfigured

checks.name: default-eval-path
checks.description: Uses the v3 default evaluate checklist path

checks.name: fail-closed-rules
checks.description: Evaluate checklist keeps a fail-closed posture

checks.name: blind-integrity-reminder
checks.description: Reminds the user not to leak checklist detail into the PRD

checks.name: no-hand-written-agent-flags
checks.description: Does not hand-write validator CLI flags or model names; the agent preset owns those

evals.prompt: When should I enable chainValidation for my harness recipe, and what YAML fields do I need?
evals.expected_output: Explains that CHAIN is opt-in and requires EVALUATE, that network must be testnet, that an ECDSA operator is supplied through environment variables, and that assertions must be flagged executableWithTestSigner to actually transact.

checks.name: mentions-chain-validation
checks.description: Names the chainValidation block

checks.name: requires-testnet
checks.description: States the network must be testnet

checks.name: mentions-operator-env
checks.description: Operator credentials come from environment variables

checks.name: requires-ecdsa
checks.description: Calls out that the operator must be ECDSA, not ED25519

checks.name: ties-to-executable-flag
checks.description: Links chainValidation to executableWithTestSigner assertions

checks.name: requires-evaluate
checks.description: States that CHAIN depends on EVALUATE

evals.prompt: My .harness/spec.yaml has an extend.baseline block, a contract: key, and no schemaVersion. I want to add a new page to the recipe — can you edit it for me?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a pre-v3 recipe, declines to treat it as loadable, explains that hedera-harness migrate is gone, and recommends rewriting to schemaVersion 3 (extend.baseline → baseline, contract: → eval:) or regenerating with init.

checks.name: detects-stale-schema
checks.description: Identifies the recipe as predating schema v3

checks.name: no-migrate-command
checks.description: Does not recommend the removed migrate command as the path forward

checks.name: names-key-renames
checks.description: Explains extend.baseline → baseline and contract → eval

evals.prompt: I want the harness to build a whole HTS subscription feature: the token service layer, a management UI, and wallet-gated mint flows. Should that be one PRD or several?
evals.expected_output: Weighs a single PRD against ordered increments, recommends splitting only because this spans layers, explains that prd accepts a list delivered in order onto one branch, that each increment must leave the app green, and that eval: should be listed 1:1 with prd: so each slice is graded against its own checklist.

checks.name: explains-increments
checks.description: Explains that prd can be an ordered list of increments

checks.name: each-increment-green
checks.value: (green|passes on its own|own attempt budget|validated per increment)
checks.description: Each increment must leave the app green on its own

checks.name: stops-on-failure
checks.description: A failing increment stops the sequence

checks.name: orders-by-dependency
checks.description: Orders increments by dependency, not size

checks.name: single-branch
checks.description: Increments deliver onto a single branch

checks.name: pairs-eval-list
checks.description: Pairs eval: 1:1 with prd: for per-increment grading
